en: The Preface to the Commentary on the *Sūtra of Perfect Enlightenment*, Part One: Structural Outline.

This preface intends to express gratitude for the Buddha’s grace, praise the Dharma, and benefit sentient beings. It unfolds its meaning and arranges its text according to the sequence of the title. The section beginning with “Now, all things possessing blood and breath must have consciousness” and ending with “in reality, they are all one Way” describes how, despite differences in phenomenal manifestations, these correspond to the two characters “Perfect Enlightenment” (*yuanjue*) in the title.

The section from “That which has been realized by the Buddhas of the three periods” down to “serving as the source of all sūtras” corresponds to the three characters “Sūtra of Definitive Meaning” (*liaoyi jing*) in the title. The final section concerning the origin and conclusion of the composition of this commentary pertains to the character “Commentary” (*shu*) in the title.
